integrity: Exponential limit and sign frontier established analytically using a cited prior theorem; finite exact-arithmetic checks are corroborative, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Fixed-degree/fixed-index large-girth asymptotic only; no explicit girth threshold, no uniformity for indices growing with order, and no global unimodality assertion. Depends on a published high-girth Tutte-evaluation theorem; historical priority is provisional.
title: Sharp fixed-index curvature frontier for the \(\tau\)-polynomials of high-girth regular graphs
